# Helen Mulder OT

This website contains the clinical observations and writings of Helen Mulder, an Occupational Therapist focused on Neuro-metabolic rehabilitation.

## Articles (Markdown available)
Raw markdown for every article is available alongside the HTML version. Replace `published_article.html` with `<slug>.md` to read the raw, high-signal data.

Example:
- HTML: `https://helenmulder.com/some-article/published_article.html`
- Markdown: `https://helenmulder.com/some-article/some-article.md`

## Index/Archive
The full archive index can be read as markdown at `/archive/index.md` (if dynamically generated) or parsed from the HTML sitemap.
